newsitem.title: USA: Midwest Cash Grain PM - Movement in east said slow.
newsitem.headline: Midwest Cash Grain PM - Movement in east said slow.

text.p: Muddy fields from Thursday's heavy rains in the Midwest kept farmers from harvesting corn and soybeans in the eastern corn belt on Friday, and cash grain movement was slow as a result, grain dealers said.
"We got two and one-half inches of rain on Thursday, although some areas near here will run corn tomorrow," one Ohio-based grain merchant said.
Basis bids were mostly flat to slightly higher.
Harvest progress remained highly variable. There is still plenty of eastern corn and soybean crops in the field, while farmers in the west were expected to finish this weekend.
One southern Ohio dealer estimated that 90 percent of his area's corn crop was in the bin, while only 10 percent of the corn crop had been harvested.
Rain in Iowa this week slowed harvest in that state and that corn crop was expected to be 85 percent harvested by this weekend, a Nebraska merchandiser said.
Basis values are quoted against CBOT futures, cash $/bu.
Wheat millers no bid no bid
Note: UNQ=Unquoted. Z=CBOT Dec, X=CBOT Nov, F=CBOT Jan.
